_about: The passers-by on the pavement in front of the headquarters. They are scenery, not the studio's staff: no desk, no role, no Character Bible entry. Each starts from a MetaHuman Creator preset and is built the same way the employees are (rig_employees.py with AMN_PEOPLE_CONFIG=street_people.json), into its own folder so the studio's people stay separate.
